facts.raw_span: A 40-year-old man presented with a painful nodule on the lower part of his right leg
the lesion had been stable in size and painless for 4 years but had enlarged and become tender over the past 6 months
an irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm was noted just above the lateral malleolus of the right leg
No popliteal or inguinal lymphadenopathy was present
there were no other suspicious cutaneous lesions
Routine blood tests, including complete blood count, fasting blood sugar, liver and renal function tests, were within normal limits
Tests for hepatitis B surface antigen and HIV were negative
a lobulated, tan-gray, firm mass partly covered by skin, measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm
nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma
Mitotic figures, including atypical forms, measured 7–8 per 10 high-power fields
Immunohistochemical staining showed strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45
The tumor cells were negative for S-100 protein, pancytokeratin, epithelial membrane antigen, and CD31

concepts.why: The presence of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, is consistent with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

The presence of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with mitotic figures, including atypical forms, is consistent with leiomyosarcoma.

The presence of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, is consistent with malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

The presence of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with mitotic figures, including atypical forms, is consistent with undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
The focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45 is consistent with melanoma, although the overall histological features are not typical of this diagnosis.

The presence of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma, along with mitotic figures, including atypical forms, is consistent with soft tissue sarcoma.

rationales.F01: The presence of a painful nodule on the lower part of the leg is non-specific and could be related to various conditions.
rationales.F02: The change in size and tenderness of the lesion over time suggests a possible malignant process, which is more typical of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
rationales.F03: The description of the mass as irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, and tender is consistent with a soft tissue tumor, but not specific enough to rule in or out any particular diagnosis.
rationales.F09: The presence of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli within a collagenous stroma is highly suggestive of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
rationales.F10: The high mitotic rate, including atypical forms, is concerning for malignancy and supports the diagnosis of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
rationales.F11: The strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, along with the absence of other specific markers, supports the diagnosis of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
rationales.F12: The absence of specific markers such as S-100 protein, pancytokeratin, epithelial membrane antigen, and CD31 helps to rule out other diagnoses and supports the diagnosis of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
